joinguardDescription: Stop the accounts that look like a raid or a spam bot when they join.
showDescription: Show how the join guard is set up, its rules and what it did this week.
postButtonDescription: Post the checkpoint button in the checkpoint channel, or edit the one I posted.
enableDescription: Turn the join guard on: I check the members who join against its rules.
disableDescription: Turn the join guard off. The rules and the settings are kept.
verifyDescription: Let a member in past the join guard: I take the pending role and give the verified one.
showWeek: **This week**: {{stopped}} stopped, {{waiting}} waiting at the checkpoint now.
showRulesNone: No rule yet: add them on the dashboard, at {{url}}.
enabled: {{GREENTICK}} The join guard is on: I check the members who join against its rules.
enabledNoRules: {{GREENTICK}} The join guard is on, but it has no rule yet: add them on the dashboard, at {{url}}.
disabled: {{GREENTICK}} The join guard is off. The members who wait at the checkpoint still can pass it.
alreadyEnabled: The join guard is already on.
alreadyDisabled: The join guard is already off.
logChannelMissingPermissions: I cannot post the logs of the join guard in {{channel}}, I am missing: {{missing, list(conjunction)}}.
logChannelUnknown: I cannot find the log channel of the join guard, {{channel}}: set another one, or none, in `/settings server` or on the dashboard.
postButtonPosted: {{GREENTICK}} I posted the checkpoint button in {{channel}}.
postButtonEdited: {{GREENTICK}} I updated the checkpoint button in {{channel}}.
postButtonNoChannel: The join guard has no checkpoint channel: set `join-guard.checkpoint-channel` in {{command}} or on the dashboard.
postButtonFailed: I could not post the checkpoint button: {{error}}
verifyNothing: {{user}} does not wait at the checkpoint, and the join guard has no pending or verified role to change.
